sentences.en: Eastern equine encephalitis occurs in eastern and southeastern United States; western equine and California encephalitis occur throughout the West; and St. Louis encephalitis occurs throughout the country.

sentences.en: Called encephalitis, this condition can occur up to several weeks after the basic measles symptoms have resolved.

sentences.en: Long-term problems following recovery from measles encephalitis may include seizures and mental retardation.

sentences.en: Serious infections that affect the brain directly, such as meningitis and encephalitis, may cause irreversible damage to the brain, leading to CP.
